messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "do not use a second device unless you are told to"
set: ["do not use a second device unless you are told to", "do not stop unless doctor tells you to", "do not stop taking unless doctor tells you to", "do not use anti-diarrhea medicine unless doctor instructs", "do not reuse the device", "most people are told not to eat less potassium", "use a medicine dose-measuring device", "do not use more than one dose in a 24-hour period unless your doctor tells you to", "do not change dose or stop unless doctor tells you to", "do not stop taking before surgery unless surgeon tells you to", "do not use a kitchen spoon", "do not change dose or stop suddenly unless you have a seizure", "avoid potassium supplements or salt substitutes unless doctor has told you to", "do not use a teaspoon or tablespoon", "most people are told to eat more potassium", "do not stop using carvedilol before surgery unless your surgeon tells you to"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
